title: GLDAS-2.2 Catchment Land Surface Model with GRACE data assimilation, daily 0.25° (GLDAS_CLSM025_DA1_D v2.2)
description: Daily global land-surface fields from NASA's Global Land Data Assimilation System version 2.2, simulated with the Catchment land surface model (CLSM-F2.5) in the Land Information System and constrained by assimilating GRACE and GRACE-FO terrestrial water storage anomalies. The product provides 24 land surface fields at 0.25°, including groundwater storage, terrestrial water storage, surface, root-zone and profile soil moisture, evapotranspiration components, runoff, snow and energy fluxes, from 1 February 2003 to present. Meteorological forcing fields are not distributed because of the data agreement with ECMWF.
purpose: Gives a model-based, GRACE-constrained estimate of groundwater and soil-moisture storage at 0.25° and daily time steps, useful to interpret storage trends and drought in Algeria alongside raw GRACE data.

spatial_extent.description: Global land from 60° S to 90° N (CMR bounding rectangle −180/−60/180/90) on a 0.25° grid; Algeria is fully inside the domain. Users subset the global daily files.

temporal_extent.description: 1 February 2003 to present. The latest granule in CMR on 2026-11-22 was for 30 September 2026 (8,643 granules). Latency is about 2–6 months because GRACE data are assimilated; an Early Product without GRACE assimilation (GLDAS_CLSM025_DA1_D_EP) is issued first and removed when the main product is available.

format: NetCDF-4 (.nc4, one global file per day, about 21 MB)

variables.name: GWS_tavg
variables.description: Groundwater storage (computed as TWS − root-zone soil moisture − snow water equivalent − canopy interception)

variables.name: TWS_tavg
variables.description: Terrestrial water storage (soil water, snow, canopy water and groundwater)

variables.name: SoilMoist_P_tavg
variables.description: Profile soil moisture (depth varies by grid cell)

variables.name: Evap_tavg (and ESoil_tavg, ECanop_tavg, TVeg_tavg)
variables.description: Evapotranspiration and its bare-soil, canopy-interception and transpiration components

processing: Catchment-F2.5 model in LIS version 7, started on 1 February 2003 from the GLDAS-2.0 daily Catchment simulation, forced by ECMWF Integrated Forecasting System analysis fields and assimilating GRACE/GRACE-FO terrestrial water storage anomalies (CSR RL06 mascons; Li et al., 2019). CLSM has no explicit soil layers: soil moisture is represented by inclusive surface (0–2 cm), root-zone (0–100 cm) and profile reservoirs, and it simulates shallow groundwater (GLDAS-2 README).
validation: Li et al. (2019) evaluate the global GRACE data assimilation against groundwater and other observations; no accuracy figure is given in the CMR record or README sections read for this entry.
limitations: Model estimate: groundwater and soil-moisture partitioning depend on the Catchment model and ECMWF forcing; GRACE only constrains total storage at about 300 km scale, so 0.25° detail comes from the model.
Combining GLDAS-2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 into one series can create discontinuities (different forcing and data assimilation) (README).
Latency of 2–6 months; meteorological forcing fields are not distributed.
Downloads (HTTPS, OPeNDAP, Earthdata Search) require a free NASA Earthdata Login.

algeria_notes: Useful for groundwater-storage and root-zone soil-moisture context over the Tell, the High Plains and the Saharan aquifer systems. Because GRACE constrains only total storage at about 300 km, the split between groundwater and soil moisture and the 0.25° detail over Algeria come from the model; treat GWS_tavg as a model-dependent estimate and compare it with the raw JPL mascon and downscaled GRACE records.
